name: Storm-1099
iocPatterns: Social media accounts sharing false narratives
recommendedActions: Implement MFA for social media accounts
Enhance employee training on disinformation tactics
campaignsText: Known for campaigns like the Doppelganger sites and amplifying geopolitical claims, Storm-1099 operates with a strategic focus on timely narrative shaping during key events. Past operations include spreading disinformation related to Hamas-Ice relations and Russian involvement indicators.
description: Storm-1099 is a sophisticated Russia-affiliated influence actor conducting pro-Russia operations since Spring 2022. They use tactics like website forgery and false information campaigns, targeting those opposing Ukraine's supporters.
goals: Storm-1099 aims to sway public opinion and geopolitical dynamics through misinformation. Their targets include international supporters of Ukraine, media outlets, and activists susceptible to narrative shifts that favor Russian narratives.
